name: academic-writing-suite
description: Academic research workflow orchestrator: direction intake with study-type domain profiles (CS, prespecified clinical, systematic review, observational), deep-research capability probe (hard stop when absent), gates and stage prerequisites checked by tools/rw.py, journal confirmation, citation audit, bidirectional claim calibration, and blinded peer review in snapshot sandboxes outside the project with P0-P3 blockers. Advisor by default; sentence-level edits only on the user's explicit opt-in. Never predicts acceptance odds.
descriptionZh: 学术研究全流程编排：启动问询定写作方向与研究类型（领域档案）→深度研究能力探针（无工具即硬中断）→rw.py 校验门禁后实验设计→按档案搭骨架→目标期刊确认→引用审查→双向声明校准润色→项目外快照沙箱脱盲审稿（只给 P0-P3 阻塞点，不给录用概率/档位）。默认只给规划与修改点；用户明确要求时才进入逐句修改模式。
